cases.description: Bracket expressions: is 7+3*2 left-to-right (20) or by precedence (13); '@' as division.
cases.cnv:
OBJECT=A
A:TYPE=INTEGER
A:VALUE=0

OBJECT=S
S:TYPE=STRING
S:VALUE=

OBJECT=F
F:TYPE=BOOL
F:VALUE=FALSE

OBJECT=EXPR
EXPR:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
EXPR:CODE={A^SET([7+3*2]);S^SET([A@2]);}

OBJECT=CONCAT
CONCAT:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
CONCAT:CODE={S^SET("X");S^ADD(A);A^SET([S+1]);}

OBJECT=BODY
BODY:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
BODY:CODE={A^ADD(1);S^ADD(_I_);}

OBJECT=LOOP
LOOP:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
LOOP:CODE={@LOOP("BODY",0,5,1);}

OBJECT=LOOPSTEP
LOOPSTEP:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
LOOPSTEP:CODE={@LOOP("BODY",2,5,2);}

OBJECT=LOOPEMPTY
LOOPEMPTY:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
LOOPEMPTY:CODE={@LOOP("BODY",3,0,1);}

OBJECT=YES
YES:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
YES:CODE={S^SET("YES");}

OBJECT=NO
NO:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
NO:CODE={S^SET("NO");}

OBJECT=SIMPLE
SIMPLE:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
SIMPLE:CODE={@IF(A,">",3,"YES","NO");}

OBJECT=SIMPLEEQ
SIMPLEEQ:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
SIMPLEEQ:CODE={@IF(A,"_",5,"YES","NO");}

OBJECT=COMPOUND
COMPOUND:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
COMPOUND:CODE={@IF("A>3&&A<9","YES","NO");}

OBJECT=COMPOUNDEQ
COMPOUNDEQ:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
COMPOUNDEQ:CODE={@IF("A'5","YES","NO");}

OBJECT=UNQUOTED
UNQUOTED:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
UNQUOTED:CODE={@IF(A,">",3,YES,NO);}

OBJECT=FLIP
FLIP:TYPE=BEHAVIOUR
FLIP:CODE={F^SWITCH(TRUE,FALSE);}
